title: Potentiometer
summary: Read a 10k potentiometer on A0 and print 0-1023 to the Serial Monitor.
learningObjectives: Read an analog voltage with analogRead().
Understand a potentiometer as a voltage divider.
Print values to the Serial Monitor.
expectedBehavior: The Serial Monitor prints a value from about 0 to 1023 as the wiper moves.
wiringChecklist: Pot outer terminal B to GND.
predictPrompt: What value do you expect when the wiper is centered?
observePrompt: Drag the wiper from one end to the other. What is the range?
tryNext: Map the reading to 0-255 and print that instead.
